project_name: Dynopay Creator, Tip & Public Storefront Redesign
overview: A top 1% design system and visual blueprint for Dynopay public surfaces (Creator profile /{handle}, Tip & Support Widget flow, Public Shop /{handle}/shop, and Product Detail /{handle}/p/[slug]). Designed to break generic SaaS tropes through an editorial 2-column layout, rich tactile glassmorphism, dynamic merchant theme reactivity, and ultra-crisp crypto checkout UX.

visual_direction.desktop_layout_choice: EDITORIAL TWO-COLUMN SPLIT WITH STICKY IDENTITY RAIL
visual_direction.justification: Single-column stacked layouts hide storefront products and payment links below dense support widgets. An editorial 2-column split (380px sticky identity rail on the left, 1fr flexible action stack on the right) keeps creator identity, verification badge, bio, and quick tip action visible at all times while allowing buyers to seamlessly scroll through storefront products, donation campaigns, and payment links.

grid_and_breakpoints.tablet_md: md:grid-cols-1 gap-6 (<1024px, collapses to single column with sticky identity at top)
grid_and_breakpoints.mobile_sm: grid-cols-1 gap-4 (<640px, full-width cards, 390px mobile optimized)

cover_banner_treatment.bleed_mode: Full-bleed hero banner at page top with 24px rounded bottom corners on desktop, gradient scrim fading into canvas base, and soft radial ambient accent bleed behind content column.

merchant_theme_rules.accent_color: Merchant configured hex (defaults to Dynopay Gold #FFD100 or Aurora Indigo). Used for avatar rings, live indicator dots, progress bar gradients, chip active states, and active link borders.
cover_styles: solid (Aurora Indigo or Tinted Ink radial glow)
gradient (Editorial multi-stop blends: Sunset, Ocean, Forest, Twilight, Midnight, Candy)
image (Uploaded high-res banner with linear scrim gradient)
pattern (Dot grid matrix on accent tint)
merchant_theme_rules.contrast_guard: All text sitting directly on solid merchant accents MUST pass readableOn(hex) logic: light accents (luminance > 0.6) use near-black ink #121214 text; dark accents use pure white #FFFFFF text.
merchant_theme_rules.primary_cta_hierarchy: Only ONE primary gradient button per viewport. When Support Widget is active, its CTA uses the primary gradient; secondary links or featured campaigns adopt an outlined glass border style with hover accent glow.

hero_and_identity.avatar: 112px desktop / 96px mobile, rounded-full with 3.5px multi-stop gradient border ring (accent -> gold -> blue), 16px soft shadow, overlapping cover bottom edge by -56px.
hero_and_identity.verified_badge: 20px crisp blue/gold SVG shield badge positioned adjacent to name with hover tooltip.
hero_and_identity.share_header_button: 36px circular glass pill with share icon, triggering native share drawer on mobile or instant clipboard copy on desktop with spring checkmark animation.
hero_and_identity.social_row: Floating pill row with 42px circular glass buttons for X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, Facebook, and Personal Website.

support_widget_card.container: 3D Glassmorphic card with backdrop-blur-2xl, 1px subtle white/10 inner border, and soft radial top accent glow.
support_widget_card.header: 44px gradient icon box (coffee / tip / support icon) + Unbounded header + thanks message subtitle.
support_widget_card.preset_chips: Grid of monetary pills ($10, $25, $50, $100 + Custom). Active chip transforms with gold gradient fill, deep shadow, and -2px Y elevation.
support_widget_card.inputs: Tactile 12px rounded input fields with focus ring in accent color, character counters, and progressive 'Add receipt email' expander.
support_widget_card.goal_bar: Animated progress tube showing monthly tips raised vs goal with glow tail.
support_widget_card.supporter_wall: Live feed of recent supporters with initial avatar tiles, donor names, crypto amounts, time ago, and donor notes.

inline_checkout_phases.coin_selection: Grid of 2-col or 3-col interactive crypto tiles featuring official coin SVG icons (BTC, ETH, USDT-TRC20, USDC, SOL, XRP, BNB), real-time FX rate badge, and network label.
inline_checkout_phases.awaiting_payment: 176px white QR code panel with tap-to-copy feedback, truncated address bar with copy icon button, reservation countdown bar, and CheckoutStatusTimeline stream.
inline_checkout_phases.confirmed_state: Confetti particle burst, 'Thank you!' heading, PDF receipt download button, and a canvas-rendered 1080x1080 'TipThankYouCard' with one-click PNG download & social share buttons.

storefront_and_shop.shop_hero: CRITICAL FIX: Uses the exact same merchant theme (cover gradient/image + accent color) as the profile page for 1:1 brand consistency instead of random hash hue.
storefront_and_shop.product_card: 16:10 aspect ratio cover image with hover scale (1.04x), sold count pill, category chip, price in Unbounded font, and 'Buy now' pill CTA.
storefront_and_shop.featured_product_card: Spans 2 columns on desktop grid with side-by-side wide layout, gold 'Featured' ribbon, and expanded description preview.
storefront_and_shop.shop_toolbar: Type filter chips (All / Digital / Physical / Service), category dropdown, search box, and sort menu.

product_detail_page.layout: 2-column product split (1:1 square media gallery on left; sticky buy-box on right).
product_detail_page.gallery: Square main display + horizontal thumbnail strip with active border indicator.
product_detail_page.buy_box: Title, category tag, large price display, variant selector dropdown, quantity stepper (+/- buttons with 44px touch targets or 'One-off service' pill), $10 minimum order notice banner, Add to Cart button, and Buy Now primary CTA.
product_detail_page.trust_reassurance_strip: Horizontal trust badge row: '⚡ Instant Crypto Payment', '🔒 Non-Custodial Direct', '📄 PDF Tax Receipt'.
product_detail_page.description: Rendered markdown block with styled headings, code snippets, blockquotes, and lists.
product_detail_page.mobile_sticky_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports with product title, total price, and instant 'Buy Now' button.

micro_interactions.hover_elevation: transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease. On hover: translateY(-2px).
micro_interactions.forbidden_transition: NEVER use transition: all. Explicitly specify target CSS properties.

entrance_animations.stagger_delay: Page components stagger enter with 60ms delay (opacity 0 -> 1, translateY 12px -> 0px over 450ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)).

accessibility_rules.touch_targets: All interactive elements, buttons, and input fields MUST have minimum height/width of 44px on touch devices.
accessibility_rules.contrast_standards: Text contrast must meet APCA / WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio). All hover states explicitly define text color.
accessibility_rules.keyboard_focus: Visible focus ring (2px accent outline with 2px offset) on all focusable elements.
accessibility_rules.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling transform animations and instant state switches.

priority_implementation_order.impact: High visual lift — fixes vertical scrolling fatigue and makes shop products visible alongside identity rail.

priority_implementation_order.task: Unify ShopHero Merchant Theme with Creator Page Theme
priority_implementation_order.impact: High brand consistency — removes hardcoded hue math and reflects merchant custom cover/accent.
Higher conversion — glassmorphic preset chips, tactile inputs, QR copy feedback, and thank-you card rendering.
E-commerce trust — gallery thumbnails, sticky mobile buy bar, $10 floor alert, and reassurance strip.
Refined browsing experience with smooth card hover states, sold badges, and category filtering.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, cards, and modal dialogs MUST have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='creator-support-submit', data-testid='product-buy-now-btn').
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or sticky mobile bars. Always use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur (12-24px blur) or solid tinted surfaces.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.spacing_philosophy: Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) inside containers with borders to prevent text collision.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.typography_anti_patterns: Never use Inter for primary headings; use Unbounded (--font-hero). Use JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono for prices, crypto handles, and amounts.
